subject: Lane B source findings: exact crop scale + current 67.75° peak + geometry/frost coupling
body: CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ISSUE: current main DuoShader.concurrentCoverTiltForHinge maps 0.5..135° through a half-sine, so its normalized maximum occurs at 67.75° and it clears to zero at 135°; this does not implement Primary's new ~90° glass-peak target. CONFIRMED_SOURCE_ISSUE: duo_unfold.agsl uses the same tilt-derived gap both for ray/perspective geometry and blur radius, coupling geometry with glass intensity. CONFIRMED_SOURCE_FACT: current Fold7CoverVisualHost canonical crop Rect(984,0,1920,2184) is 936x2184 = 3:7 and maps to 1080x2520 = 3:7 at an exact uniform 15/13 scale; preserve this transform. CONFIRMED_TEST_RESULT: a separated pure model (nearest-terminal geometry 0→60°@90→0 plus independent glass=sin(pi*hinge/180)) passed 25 invariant/property checks, 100k randomized bounded-angle cases, hesitation/reversal, and 100 repeated 30–70° oscillation loops. At a synthetic 250ms open, 60Hz discrete sampling reaches 0.9866 glass peak because no frame lands exactly at 90°, while 120Hz lands exactly at 90° in that trajectory; this is cadence sampling, not model discontinuity. No device/GPU performance claim is made. Proposed compatibility boundary: add an explicit Gen5 glassEnvelope uniform/surface state while retaining legacy tilt-derived blur when envelope is unset; leave Gen4 close call sites unchanged.
